solar.name: Solar Array
solar.description: Turns sunlight into electricity. Everything on the base depends on it.

effect.mars: +25 m² of panels (about +18 kWh on a clear sol)
effect.moon: +6 m² of panels (about +26 kWh in full sunlight)

battery.name: Battery Bank
battery.description: Stores daytime energy for the night and for dark, dusty days.

effect.mars: +40 kWh storage (powers the lab for 5 nights)
effect.moon: +40 kWh storage (powers the lab for 5 nights)

greenhouse.name: Greenhouse
greenhouse.description: Grows fresh food under LED lights. Needs power and water. New beds take 10 days to mature.

effect.mars: +10 m² growing bed (+1,200 kcal/day when mature, +20 kWh/day light)
effect.moon: +10 m² growing bed (+1,200 kcal/day when mature, +20 kWh/day light)

recycler.name: Water Recycler
recycler.description: Cleans used water so it can be used again.

shielding.name: Radiation Shielding
shielding.description: A layer of regolith (surface soil) piled over the habitat to block radiation.

stormShelter.name: Storm Shelter
stormShelter.description: A small room surrounded by water tanks. The crew hides here during solar storms.

effect.mars: −90% solar storm dose while the crew shelters
effect.moon: −90% solar storm dose while the crew shelters

cleaningBot.name: Dust Cleaning Robot
cleaningBot.description: Brushes Martian dust off the solar panels automatically.

o2Generator.name: Oxygen Generator
o2Generator.description: Splits water into oxygen by electrolysis. Cannot be upgraded, but can break and be repaired.
